2607.11317.title: Calibrated e-CUSUM Decoding for Quantized Reasoning Models: Why Token Log-Probability Is the Wrong Observable for Decoding Monitors
2607.11317.paper_summary: Low-bit quantization makes small reasoning models inexpensive to deploy but can degrade their chains of thought. This motivates decoder-side monitors that intervene when generation becomes unreliable. We show that a natural candidate, the centered token log-probability increment $\log p(w_t)+H_t$, is the wrong observable for this purpose. Under the model's own sampling law it is a mean-zero martingale by construction, so it measures sampling self-consistency rather than trajectory health and is nearly silent during confident repetition, where both $\log p(w_t)$ and entropy are close to zero. We introduce a training-free decoding controller that combines (i) a degeneration-aware alarm score fusing token uncertainty with explicit verbatim repetition and (ii) a calibrated e-process-inspired sequential detector. The raw product process is Ville-valid under a conditional-mean null, while the deployed CUSUM-floored statistic is treated as an empirical change detector because the score is history-dependent and autocorrelated. On GSM8K with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B in FP16 and INT4, calibration turns a monitor that fires on 93--95% of generations into a selective detector of failing traces ($φ\approx 0.3$, precision $\approx 0.6$ against a 0.38 base rate). In this pilot, the controller reduces measured verbatim-degeneration signals and yields a positive but statistically inconclusive INT4 accuracy change from 63% to 69% (paired McNemar $p=0.18$, $n=100$), at a 28% token-budget cost. We also find that non-termination, rather than looping, is the dominant failure mode on GSM8K. The main contribution is methodological: an explanation of why centered token log-probability is inadequate for decoder monitoring and a calibrated, cautiously evaluated replacement.
2607.11317.paper_summary_zh: 低位量化使得小型推理模型的部署成本低廉，但可能會降低其思考鏈的質量。這促使我們在生成變得不可靠時，使用解碼器端的監控工具進行干預。我們顯示出一個自然的候選者，即中心化的標記對數概率增量 $\log p(w_t)+H_t$，對於這個目的來說是錯誤的可觀察量。根據模型自身的抽樣法則，它本身是一個均值為零的馬丁蓋爾，因此它測量的是抽樣自一致性，而不是軌跡健康，在自信重複期間幾乎是靜默的，這時 $\log p(w_t)$ 和熵都接近於零。我們引入了一個無需訓練的解碼控制器，該控制器結合了 (i) 一個考慮退化的警報分數，將標記不確定性與明確的逐字重複融合在一起，以及 (ii) 一個經過校準的 e-process 啟發的序列檢測器。原始產品過程在條件均值零下是 Ville 有效的，而部署的 CUSUM 底部統計被視為一個經驗變化檢測器，因為該分數是歷史依賴的且自相關。在使用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 的 FP16 和 INT4 的 GSM8K 上，校準將一個在 93--95% 的生成中觸發的監控器轉變為一個選擇性檢測失敗痕跡的檢測器 ($φ\approx 0.3$, 精確度 $\approx 0.6$ 對應於 0.38 的基準率)。在這個試點中，控制器減少了測量的逐字退化信號，並產生了一個正但統計上不確定的 INT4 準確率變化，從 63% 提升到 69%（配對 McNemar $p=0.18$, $n=100$），成本為 28% 的標記預算。我們還發現，在 GSM8K 上，非終止而不是循環是主要的失敗模式。主要貢獻在於方法論：解釋為什麼中心化的標記對數概率對於解碼器監控是不足的，以及一個經過校準、謹慎評估的替代方案。
